raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "A shared `phoneSchema` strips spaces, dashes, dots and parentheses, adds the leading `+`, and still requires 10–15 digits, so inputs like `call me` and `+7 701` are still rejected. It is used in both the book and waitlist routes, and `createBooking` and `joinWaitlist` also normalize the phone, so every variant is stored as `+77015551234` and maps to one client. The one thing I couldn't check is whether the booking wizard UI has its own client-side phone check, since the diff doesn't show it."}
